probe_manifest.hash_contract: producer_models._source_hash over selected complete DEV record metadata and array dtype/shape/bytes
probe_manifest.selection: Fixed head/tail contiguous token spans per selected layer, all KV channels; no content or target-driven selection

geometry.source: Actual returned cache tensor dimensions, not hidden_size/query_heads

prefill.scope: Instrumented forward includes actual producer hooks, diagnostic CPU copies and selected-device code emission when supplied. CPU syndrome/position packets are constructed afterward. Full raw KV remains resident.

capture.scope: Full device KV capture with CPU export; no encoded-cache attention or offload

producer_audit.rope_position_rule: contiguous absolute positions starting at zero
producer_audit.replay_device: original producer device; actual loaded Qwen3 apply_rotary_pos_emb
producer_audit.on_tile_stage: attention_forward_post_hook; before decoder layer resumes and root model returns
producer_audit.scope: Read-only inside-forward hooks; only fixed selected tile intersections exported. Hidden and projection tensors are temporary diagnostics, not free reconstruction state. Model retains full raw cache. No speed, capacity, compressed attention or serving result is implied.

evaluation.protocol: Fixed DEV diagnostics never optimize or select checkpoints. Final requested TRAIN update is always frozen; TEST never tunes.

code_summary.code_hash_contract: SHA256 over little-endian uint16 BF16 retained words in fixed record order

execution.scope: Diagnostic evaluation including CPU statistics/staging. Allocator peaks are cumulative without resetting counters; no isolated inference, kernel or serving measurement.

probe.hash_contract: producer_models._source_hash over selected complete DEV record metadata and array dtype/shape/bytes

metrics.scope: Fixed DEV observation only; no optimization/checkpoint selection/TEST, raw captures are not decoded, and group candidate byte counts exclude headers/features/state and are not encoded packet savings.

coverage_summary.interpretation: Optimizer exposure only. Initial TRAIN priors and source normalizers use all selected TRAIN captures; shared parameters may generalize to channels absent from optimizer minibatches.
